title: Transformer to GPT-5: Advancements, Limitations, and Future Directions in Large Language Model Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.34281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized Artificial Intelligence (AI) by their extraordinary capabilities, like contextual understanding, few-shot/zero-shot learning, code generation, ability to reason and problem-solving. Recent studies have shown immense work on LLMs. Yet, there is limited work on the thorough taxonomy of LLMs. This study would showcase a detailed classification of LLMs, starting with the earlier models like BERT and leading to LLMs like GPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. translated_title: 从Transformer到GPT-5：大语言模型设计的进展、局限与未来方向
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）凭借其卓越的能力彻底改变了人工智能（AI）领域，这些能力包括上下文理解、少样本/零样本学习、代码生成、推理能力和问题解决能力。近期的研究显示，关于大语言模型已有大量的工作成果。然而，针对大语言模型的全面系统性分类的研究仍然有限。本研究将展示大语言模型的详细分类，从早期的模型（如BERT）开始，一直延伸到GPT、Gemini、Claude和Grok等大语言模型。我们将深入探讨诸如用于训练大语言模型的数据集、训练期间所使用的计算能力、硬件规格、架构以及参数等主题。此外，我们还将审视其局限性、计算挑战以及开放性问题。本研究将主要聚焦于大语言模型的发展时间线，以体现其在这段时期内的成长历程。研究结果表明存在一个清晰的模式：那些能够优化架构复杂组件之间比率的模型……
tldr: 本文对从BERT到GPT、Gemini、Claude和Grok等大语言模型进行了系统性分类梳理，涵盖训练数据集、算力、硬件规格、架构与参数，并分析了其局限性、计算挑战与未来发展方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a comprehensive taxonomy of LLMs from BERT to GPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok, covering their training datasets, computational power, hardware specifications, architecture, and parameters, while analyzing their limitations, computational challenges, and future directions.
